_readme: Owner's music (2026-10-04, provided by the owner, made with an AI music tool): file in the music folder and the in-game title per disc track (1, 2, 3, 4). 'The version always stands at the end' of the file name; the assignment below is the owner's. Titles: short, vanilla-like (Pigstep, Otherside, Relic), inspired by the file names; the artist stays SimpleBuilding. Read by tools/audio/import_discs.py; a disc missing here falls back to <stem>.mp3, <stem>_alt.mp3, <stem>_3.mp3, <stem>_4.mp3.
